ArtifactIntegrity.description: The integrity facet: do these bytes still say what they said?
ArtifactIntegrity.title: ArtifactIntegrity

ArtifactIntegrityStatus.description: Whether every artifact still hashes to the digest the proof recorded.
ArtifactIntegrityStatus.title: ArtifactIntegrityStatus

ComparisonValidity.description:
The comparison facet, bound to the Campaign it is a comparison of.

Both difference digests are carried because either one alone proves
nothing. The declared digest is what the Campaign permitted; the observed
digest is what the two arms actually differed by. A comparison is valid
when they are the same digest, and when they are not, the reason codes say
what went wrong rather than leaving a reader to diff two hashes.
ComparisonValidity.title: ComparisonValidity

ComparisonValidityStatus.description:
Whether the two arms differed only where the Campaign declared.

``indeterminate`` is not a softer ``invalid``. It says the evidence does
not establish either answer, which is a different thing to tell a reader
than "the comparison broke its own contract".
ComparisonValidityStatus.title: ComparisonValidityStatus

ExecutionLocationKind.description: Where the work ran. v0.2.0 emits ``local`` and nothing else.
ExecutionLocationKind.title: ExecutionLocationKind

ExecutionObservation.description:
Every independent observation of one execution, accumulated.

The three blocks are not ranked against each other by the model, because
they are not alternatives: a run can be participant-attested and
provider-recorded and provider-attested at once, and each says something
the other two do not. :func:`provider_verification_claim` is where the
accumulation is reduced to a sentence.
ExecutionObservation.title: ExecutionObservation

ModelPinStrength.description:
How tightly the subject model was pinned.

Ordered by what it lets a reader conclude, weakest first: an alias can move
under a Campaign, a provider revision cannot but is still the provider's
word for it, and an artifact digest names bytes.
ModelPinStrength.title: ModelPinStrength

ParticipantAttestation.description: What the participant asserted, and which key asserted it.
ParticipantAttestation.title: ParticipantAttestation

ParticipantAttestationStatus.description: Whether the participant's own signature over the run checks out.
ParticipantAttestationStatus.title: ParticipantAttestationStatus

ProviderAttestation.description: A provider-signed assertion, absent until a real one exists.
ProviderAttestation.title: ProviderAttestation

ProviderAttestationStatus.description: Whether the provider made a verifiable assertion about the run.
ProviderAttestationStatus.title: ProviderAttestationStatus

ProviderRecord.description: The provider's record of the run, and how it was come by.
ProviderRecord.title: ProviderRecord

ProviderRecordStatus.description:
How a provider's own record of the run reached this proof.

``participant_captured`` means a run reference was copied into the
participant-signed bundle. It is rendered as "Prime run reference
captured", never "Prime verified this run".
ProviderRecordStatus.title: ProviderRecordStatus

ReproductionKind.description:
What kind of re-run one entry is.

A same-participant run on the provider is a provider-hosted rerun. It is
never an independent reproduction, and there is no status that would let it
be described as one.
ReproductionKind.title: ReproductionKind

ReproductionRef.description:
One proof that re-ran this one, and under what configuration.

``compatibility`` carries the plan's literal compatibility outcomes rather
than importing the comparison model, so a proof can be read without the
policy that produced the verdict.
ReproductionRef.title: ReproductionRef

TraceCoverage.description: The trace facet, measured against a named profile or not at all.
TraceCoverage.title: TraceCoverage

TraceCoverageKind.description: How much of the requested trace evidence exists.
TraceCoverageKind.title: TraceCoverageKind

description: Every evidence facet of one proof.
